lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਚੜਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਨ ਬੂਡਈ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: keechaR haath na boodaee ekaa nadar nihaal ||
lines.translation: One who sees the One and Only Lord with his eyes - his hands shall not get muddy and dirty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare gur saravar sachee paal ||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; the Guru has surrounded the ocean with the embankment of Truth. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਲੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: agan marai jal loR lahu vin gur nidh jal naahi ||
lines.translation: If you wish to put out the fire, then look for water; without the Guru, the ocean of water is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam marai bharamaaeeai je lakh karam kamaahi ||
lines.translation: You shall continue to wander lost in reincarnation through birth and death, even if you do thousands of other deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam jaagaat na lagaee je chalai satigur bhaai ||
lines.translation: But you shall not be taxed by the Messenger of Death, if you walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak niramal amar pad gur har melai melaai ||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the immaculate, immortal status is obtained, and the Guru will unite you in the Lord's Union. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਛਪੜੀ ਕਊਆ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalar keree chhapaRee kaooaa mal mal naai ||
lines.translation: The crow rubs and washes itself in the mud puddle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਅਵਗੁਣੀ ਚਿੰਜੁ ਭਰੀ ਗੰਧੀ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan mailaa avagunee chi(n)j bharee ga(n)dhee aai ||
lines.translation: Its mind and body are polluted with its own mistakes and demerits, and its beak is filled with dirt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੰਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਕਾਗ ਕੁਪੰਖੀ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saravar ha(n)s na jaaniaa kaag kupa(n)khee sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: The swan in the pool associated with the crow, not knowing that it was evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat siu aisee preet hai boojhahu giaanee ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: Such is the love of the faithless cynic; understand this, O spiritually wise ones, through love and devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa jaikaar kar guramukh karam kamaau ||
lines.translation: So proclaim the victory of the Society of the Saints, and act as Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨੑਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: niramal nhaavan naanakaa gur teerath dareeaau ||10||
lines.translation: Immaculate and pure is that cleansing bath, O Nanak, at the sacred shrine of the Guru's river. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janame kaa phal kiaa ganee jaa(n) har bhagat na bhaau ||
lines.translation: What should I account as the rewards of this human life, if one does not feel love and devotion to the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੈਧਾ ਖਾਧਾ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paidhaa khaadhaa baad hai jaa(n) man doojaa bhaau ||
lines.translation: Wearing clothes and eating food is useless, if the mind is filled with the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vekhan sunanaa jhooth hai mukh jhoothaa aalaau ||
lines.translation: Seeing and hearing is false, if one speaks lies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too hor haumai aavau jaau ||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; everything else is coming and going in egotism. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈਨਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਣੇ ਫੈਲ ਫਕੜੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: hain virale naahee ghane phail phakaR sa(n)saar ||12||
lines.translation: The Saints are few and far between; everything else in the world is just a pompous show. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗੀ ਤੁਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਜੀਵਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak lagee tur marai jeevan naahee taan ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who is struck by the Lord dies instantaneously; the power to live is lost.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੋਟੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਲਗੀ ਸਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chotai setee jo marai lagee saa paravaan ||
lines.translation: If someone dies by such a stroke, then he is accepted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਲਗੀ ਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no laae tis lagai lagee taa paravaan ||
lines.translation: He alone is struck, who is struck by the Lord; after such a stroke, he is approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪੈਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: piram paikaam na nikalai laaiaa tin sujaan ||13||
lines.translation: The arrow of love, shot by the All-knowing Lord, cannot be pulled out. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਧੋਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਿ ਕਚਾ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaa(n)daa dhovai kaun j kachaa saajiaa ||
lines.translation: Who can wash the unbaked clay pot?

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੂ ਪੰਜਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਕੂੜਾ ਪਾਜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaatoo pa(n)j ralaai kooRaa paajiaa ||
lines.translation: Joining the five elements together, the Lord made a false cover.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਆਣਗੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaa(n)daa aanag raas jaa(n) tis bhaavasee ||
lines.translation: When it pleases Him, He makes it right.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਗਾਇ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਾਵਸੀ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: param jot jaagaai vaajaa vaavasee ||14||
lines.translation: The supreme light shines forth, and the celestial song vibrates and resounds. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਜਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਘੂਪ ਕਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahu j a(n)dhe ghoop kahiaa birad na jaananee ||
lines.translation: Those who are totally blind in their minds, do not have the integrity to keep their word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਊਂਧੈ ਕਵਲ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੂਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: man a(n)dhai oo(n)dhai kaval disan khare karoop ||
lines.translation: With their blind minds, and their upside-down heart-lotus, they look totally ugly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੁਝਨਿ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik kahi jaanan kahiaa bujhan te nar sughaR saroop ||
lines.translation: Some know how to speak and understand what they are told. Those people are wise and good-looking.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਦੁ ਨ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਗੀਅ ਰਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa naad na bed na gee ras ras kas na jaana(n)t ||
lines.translation: Some do not know the Sound-current of the Naad, spiritual wisdom or the joy of song. They do not even understand good and bad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਅਕਲਿ ਸਰ ਅਖਰ ਕਾ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਲਹੰਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa sidh na budh na akal sar akhar kaa bheu na laha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Some have no idea of perfection, wisdom or understanding; they know nothing about the mystery of the Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਅਸਲਿ ਖਰ ਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੰਤ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te nar asal khar j bin gun garab kara(n)t ||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those people are really donkeys; they have no virtue or merit, but still, they are very proud. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੁ ਜੋ ਬਿੰਦੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: so brahaman jo bi(n)dai braham ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam kamaavai karam ||
lines.translation: He chants and meditates, and practices austerity and good deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਰਖੈ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: seel sa(n)tokh kaa rakhai dharam ||
lines.translation: He keeps to the Dharma, with faith, humility and contentment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan toRai hovai mukat ||
lines.translation: Breaking his bonds, he is liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੁ ਪੂਜਣ ਜੁਗਤੁ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: soee brahaman poojan jugat ||16||
lines.translation: Such a Brahmin is worthy of being worshipped. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੋ ਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਾ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: khatree so j karamaa kaa soor ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Kh'shaatriyaa, who is a hero in good deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pu(n)n daan kaa karai sareer ||
lines.translation: He uses his body to give in charity;

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: khet pachhaanai beejai daan ||
lines.translation: he understands his farm, and plants the seeds of generosity.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: so khatree daragah paravaan ||
lines.translation: Such a Kh'shaatriyaa is accepted in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਜੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lab lobh je kooR kamaavai ||
lines.translation: Whoever practices greed, possessiveness and falsehood,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: apanaa keetaa aape paavai ||17||
lines.translation: shall receive the fruits of his own labors. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਨ ਤਪਾਇ ਤਨੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਣੁ ਹਡ ਨ ਬਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan na tapaai tanoor jiu baalan had na baal ||
lines.translation: Do not heat your body like a furnace, or burn your bones like firewood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਫੇੜਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: sir pairee kiaa pheRiaa a(n)dar piree samhaal ||18||
lines.translation: What have your head and feet done wrong? See your Husband Lord within yourself. ||18||
